integrity: The universal bound is established analytically. The bundled program performs deterministic sanity checks only and is not used to infer the universal quantifier. The source's first public date is the arXiv v1 submission date, not the journal date.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly the three-preparation, two-binary-measurement qubit witness J3. It does not characterize the entire fixed-dimension correlation body, give higher-dimensional analogues, or provide finite-statistics robustness bounds. Literature searches cannot exclude a poorly indexed later proof.
title: The arcsine three-preparation witness is exactly bounded for all qubit POVMs
